newsitem.title: USA: CKE to buy Hardee's from Imasco.
newsitem.headline: CKE to buy Hardee's from Imasco.

text.p: CKE Restaurants Inc, known for its Carl's Jr. fast food chain, said Monday it agreed to acquire Hardee's Food Systems Inc, from Imasco Ltd in a deal valued at about $327 million.
CKE said in a statement it will pay a net book value of about $327 million for the 788 company-operated Hardee's and 2,364 franchised Hardee's restaurants.

The acquisition is aimed at expanding the Carl's Jr. brand beyond the West Coast. Hardee's restaurants are located in 40 states, mainly in the southeast and midwest United States, and 10 foreign countries.

Hardee's is ranked either number one or two by market share in half of the markets in which it operates. More than 550 of Carl's Jr.'s 676 restaurants are located in California. It ranks number two throughout most of the state.
"This is a strong marriage of two well-known brands," said William Foley II, CKE's chairman and chief executive officer.

"Teaming Carl's Jr.'s big, juicy charbroiled burgers with Hardee's superior breakfasts enables us to showcase each chain's strengths. By dual branding the concepts, Carl's Jr. can enter established markets beyond the West Coast," he said.

Hardee's has about 30 percent of its sales during breakfast, the highest in the quick-service segment. For the last fiscal year, Hardee's restaurant sales were $2.98 billion while CKE Restaurants' were $742 million.
CKE said it will start by dual branding Hardee's with Carl's Jr. restaurants in two test markets offering Hardee's breakfast and Carl's Jr. lunch and dinner menus.
The conversion process for two test markets should take four to six months and will include about 50 Hardee's locations, in Peoria, Illinois and in a second yet to be decided test market.
During the test period the rest of the Hardee's system will offer new products based upon Carl's Jr. menu.

"We look forward to working together with (president and chief executive of Hardee's) Steve McManus and his management team in helping Hardee's to earnings recovery through major improvements in store-level margins by increasing sales and operating more efficiently," said Tom Thompson, president and chief operating officer of CKE.

Thompson said he sees significant operating synergies, including enhanced marketing and media buying power, leveraged purchasing power, and reduced costs associated with shared technologies and administrative functions.

CKE Restaurants and its subsidiaries operate a total of 928 restaurants under several brands including Carl's Jr., Rally's, Carl's Jr./Green Burrito, Taco Bueno, JB's Restaurants as well as HomeTown Buffet restaurants and Galaxy Diner restaurants.
